logistics.format: Web-based proctored, open-book reference (ProctorU or PearsonVUE)

recommended_certs.rationale: GICSP で IT/OT 横断の素養を持ったうえで、NERC CIP に特化する GCIP に進むと電力系コンプライアンス職に直結する。

plus.note: 北米電力 NERC CIP の遵守要員教育として明確な需要がある。

minus.note: NERC CIP は北米電力規制であり、日本/EU 圏では需要が限定的。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 1, specialty: 2. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded NERC CIP alignment is a specific critical-infrastructure regulatory specialization; accreditation supports credibility, but North American demand and limited Japanese applicability prevent treating it as broad OT seniority.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded accreditation and NERC CIP alignment support professional compliance responsibility for North American critical infrastructure. Its regional scope and absence of a recorded practical restrict how much it says about general OT response capability.

alex-novak.rationale: The record specifically ties this credential to North American NERC CIP compliance for electricity infrastructure. That regional regulatory branch fits specialty better than a general progression rank for an EU consultant.
